stories.title: Shanahan: Crash was my fault, report was wrong
stories.summary: 49ers coach Kyle Shanahan wanted to make clear he was at fault for the car accident that left him with serious injuries two weeks ago.

stories.title: Sources: Browns' Ward again NFL's top-paid DB
stories.summary: The Browns and five-time Pro Bowl cornerback Denzel Ward reached agreement on a two-year, $62.2 million deal that includes $52.3 million guaranteed, sources told ESPN's Adam Schefter and NFL Network's Ian Rapoport.

stories.title: Sources: UEFA weighs WC boycott over FIFA plan
stories.summary: UEFA is set to hold an emergency meeting this week, sources told ESPN, to discuss plans, including a potential World Cup boycott, to oppose a FIFA proposal to raise $20 billion from a sale of equity to outside investors.

stories.title: Jays' Bieber walks 6 in 1st inning vs. Nationals
stories.summary: Toronto Blue Jays pitcher Shane Bieber, a former Cy Young Award winner, issued walks to six of the nine batters he faced Tuesday night, including three with the bases loaded, before departing after two-thirds of an inning against the Washington Nationals.

stories.title: Mead fractured wrist in Red Sox debut, test shows
stories.summary: Follow-up tests Tuesday on new Red Sox INF Curtis Mead revealed a fractured left wrist.
